Directory of Long-Form SMB/RE Writers

The Tweet

Recently I found myself longing for deeper, long-form content from the SMB and RE community:

I’m petitioning SMB and RE Twitter to start blogging again. There’s an incredible amount of knowledge being passed around through back-channels and deep inside replies that we can all benefit from. Found something that works? Write about it! Already writing? Drop your link!
